A crunchy, wholesome blend of rolled oats mixed with a variety of nuts and seeds, lightly sweetened with natural sweeteners. Packed with fibre, protein, and essential nutrients like iron and magnesium, without any artificial additives. Oats granola provides a sustained energy release, supports digestive health, and helps maintain healthy cholesterol levels. Its deliciously crunchy texture and versatility make it an ideal breakfast option or snack, perfect for fueling your day with natural goodness.

Mchanganyiko wa oats na jamii mbalimbali za karanga na mbegu, wenye lishe na unaokatika vizuri kinywani, uliotiwa utamu kidogo kwa vitamu vya asili. Una nyuzinyuzi nyingi, protini na virutubisho muhimu kama madini chuma na magnesiamu, bila viongezi bandia vyovyote. Oats Granola inakupa nguvu taratibu kwa muda mrefu, inasaidia mmeng'enyo wa chakula na kudumisha kiwango kizuri cha lehemu (kolesteroli). Ni tamu na unaweza kuila kwa namna nyingi, hivyo ni chaguo bora kwa kifungua kinywa au asusa, ikikupa nguvu za asili siku nzima.

Abundant in beta-glucan, antioxidants, and essential minerals, our Healthy Muesli promotes heart health and immune function.
Healthy Muesli yetu imejaa beta-glucan, vilinda seli (antioxidants) na madini muhimu, na inasaidia afya ya moyo na kuimarisha kinga ya mwili.

A naturally sweet and wholesome granola made with fibre-rich dates, crunchy nuts, nutrient-packed seeds, and whole oats. Free from refined sugar, this granola is perfect for a healthy breakfast or snack, offering a delicious balance of sweetness and nutrition to energise your day!

Granola yenye utamu wa asili na lishe tele, iliyotengenezwa kwa tende zenye nyuzinyuzi nyingi, jamii ya karanga zinazokatika kinywani, mbegu zenye virutubisho na oats nzima. Haina sukari iliyosafishwa, hivyo ni nzuri kwa kifungua kinywa au asusa yenye afya, ikikupa ladha tamu na lishe kwa pamoja ili kuipa siku yako nguvu!
A blend of oats, nuts, and seeds, rich in flavour. Perfectly crafted for balance and health.
Mchanganyiko wa oats, jamii ya karanga na mbegu, wenye ladha tele. Umeandaliwa kwa umakini kwa ajili ya mlo wenye uwiano na afya njema.
Nutrient-rich oats, seeds, and nuts, tailored for nursing mothers. Natural, wholesome, and energizing.
Oats, mbegu na jamii ya karanga zenye virutubisho tele, zilizoandaliwa mahsusi kwa mama wanaonyonyesha. Ni ya asili, ina lishe na inakuongezea nguvu.
Crunchy, low-carb nuts and seeds, with a hint of natural sweetness. Perfectly keto, satisfyingly delicious.
Jamii ya karanga na mbegu zinazokatika kinywani, zenye wanga kidogo na utamu wa asili kwa mbali. Inafaa kabisa kwa mlo wa keto, na ladha yake inaridhisha.

Dive into the tropical goodness of our Coconut Granola, a delightful blend of crunchy oats, toasted coconut flakes, nuts, seeds, and natural sweeteners. Packed with fibre and healthy fats, this 650g pack is perfect for a wholesome breakfast, snack, or topping for your favourite smoothie bowl. Satisfyingly delicious and nourishing!

Furahia ladha ya kitropiki ya Coconut Granola yetu, mchanganyiko mtamu wa oats zinazokatika kinywani, vipande vya nazi vilivyokaangwa, jamii ya karanga, mbegu na vitamu vya asili. Ina nyuzinyuzi nyingi na mafuta yenye afya, na pakiti hii ya 650g ni nzuri kwa kifungua kinywa chenye lishe, asusa, au kunyunyiza juu ya bakuli lako la smoothie unalolipenda. Ni tamu kweli, tena ina lishe tele!

A crunchy, wholesome blend of oats, peanuts, pumpkin seeds, walnuts, raisins, almonds, peanuts, milk chocolate chips and lightly sweetened with natural sweeteners (honey). It is packed with fibre, protein, and essential nutrients like iron and magnesium without any artificial additives. Organic granola provides a sustained energy release, supports digestive health, and helps maintain healthy cholesterol levels. Its deliciously crunchy texture and versatility make it an ideal breakfast option or snack for children from 1 year old.

Mchanganyiko wa oats, karanga, mbegu za maboga, jozi, zabibu kavu, lozi na vipande vidogo vya chokoleti ya maziwa, wenye lishe na unaokatika vizuri kinywani, uliotiwa utamu kidogo kwa kitamu cha asili (asali). Una nyuzinyuzi nyingi, protini na virutubisho muhimu kama madini chuma na magnesiamu, bila viongezi bandia vyovyote. Granola hii inampa mtoto nguvu taratibu kwa muda mrefu, inasaidia mmeng'enyo wa chakula na kudumisha kiwango kizuri cha lehemu (kolesteroli). Ni tamu na inaweza kuliwa kwa namna nyingi, hivyo ni chaguo bora la kifungua kinywa au asusa kwa watoto kuanzia umri wa mwaka 1.

Fuel your day with a delicious crunch! Packed with roasted nuts, wholesome oats, and a hint of natural sweetness, our Nutty Granola is the perfect blend of taste and nutrition. Enjoy it with milk, yoghurt, or straight from the jar; every bite boosts energy and flavour!

Ipe siku yako nguvu kwa granola tamu inayokatika kinywani! Nutty Granola yetu imejaa jamii ya karanga zilizokaangwa, oats zenye lishe na utamu wa asili kwa mbali, hivyo ni mchanganyiko kamili wa ladha na lishe. Ifurahie na maziwa, yogati, au moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye chupa; kila tafuno linakuongezea nguvu na ladha!

"Lactating Mom Feed" is a nutritional supplement designed to meet the dietary needs of breastfeeding mothers. It is enriched with essential vitamins, minerals, and omega-3 fatty acids from oats, fenugreek, and a mixture of nuts and seeds to enhance breast milk quality and support maternal health.

"Lactating Mom Feed" ni kirutubisho cha ziada kilichoandaliwa kukidhi mahitaji ya lishe ya mama wanaonyonyesha. Kimeongezewa vitamini muhimu, madini na mafuta ya omega-3 yanayotokana na oats, uwatu (fenugreek) na mchanganyiko wa jamii ya karanga na mbegu, ili kuboresha ubora wa maziwa ya mama na kusaidia afya ya mama mwenyewe.

This carefully crafted, low-GI porridge blend is designed to support balanced blood sugar levels for individuals with diabetes. Made with wholesome ingredients like oats, chickpeas, coconut, and a variety of nuts and seeds like almonds, walnuts, hazelnuts, peanuts, and flaxseeds, it's packed with fibre, essential nutrients, and slow-digesting carbohydrates to provide sustained energy. Free from added sugars and artificial additives, this porridge is nutritious and delicious, making it the perfect choice for a healthy start to the day or a wholesome snack.

Mchanganyiko huu wa uji wenye GI ya chini umeandaliwa kwa umakini ili kuwasaidia wenye kisukari kuwa na sukari mwilini iliyotulia. Umetengenezwa kwa viambato bora kama oats, dengu na nazi, pamoja na jamii ya karanga na mbegu za aina mbalimbali, zikiwemo lozi, jozi (walnuts), hazelnuts, karanga na mbegu za kitani. Una nyuzinyuzi nyingi, virutubisho muhimu na wanga unaomeng'enywa polepole, hivyo hukupa nguvu kwa muda mrefu. Hauna sukari iliyoongezwa wala viambato bandia. Ni uji wenye lishe na ladha nzuri, chaguo bora la kuanza siku kwa afya au kama asusa yenye lishe.

Macros Baby Date Uji is a nut-free baby food blend made with whole grains, dates and banana. It is smooth, naturally sweet, and ideal for making soft porridge for babies, especially those who are sensitive to nuts.

Macros Baby Date Uji ni mchanganyiko wa chakula cha mtoto usio na karanga za aina yoyote, uliotengenezwa kwa nafaka zisizokobolewa, tende na ndizi mbivu. Ni laini, una utamu wa asili, na unafaa sana kupikia uji laini kwa watoto wachanga, hasa wale ambao karanga haziwafai.

Macros Baby Creamy Whole Grain, Nuts & Banana is a natural baby porridge blend made with whole grains, nuts, and banana. It is creamy, filling, and gently flavored to support everyday baby meals. Note: because it contains nuts, it should not be used for babies with nut allergies.

Macros Baby Creamy Whole Grain, Nuts & Banana ni mchanganyiko asilia wa uji wa mtoto, uliotengenezwa kwa nafaka zisizokobolewa, jamii ya karanga na ndizi mbivu. Ni laini kama krimu, unashibisha, na una ladha isiyo kali inayomfaa mtoto katika milo yake ya kila siku. Zingatia: kwa kuwa una jamii ya karanga, usimpe mtoto mwenye mzio wa karanga.
Unrefined wholegrain flour, milled fine for porridge and baking.
Unga wa nafaka zisizokobolewa, uliosagwa laini kwa ajili ya uji na kuoka.

"Oats Flour" is a versatile and nutritious flour made by grinding whole oat grains into a fine powder. Rich in fibre and protein, it's an excellent alternative to traditional wheat flour, offering a slightly sweet and nutty flavour. Oat flour is commonly used in baking and cooking to create healthier versions of bread, pancakes, muffins, and other baked goods. It's also gluten-free, making it a popular choice for those with gluten sensitivities.

"Unga wa Oats" ni unga wenye lishe unaotengenezwa kwa kusaga punje nzima za oats hadi ziwe unga laini, na unafaa kwa mapishi mengi. Una nyuzinyuzi na protini kwa wingi, pamoja na utamu kidogo na ladha inayofanana na ya karanga, hivyo ni mbadala mzuri wa unga wa ngano wa kawaida. Hutumika sana kuoka na kupika vyakula vyenye afya zaidi, kama mikate, chapati za maji, keki ndogo (muffins) na vyakula vingine vya kuoka. Pia hauna gluteni, kwa hiyo unapendwa na wale ambao gluteni haiwafai.

"Whole Wheat Flour" is made by grinding the entire wheat kernel, including the bran, germ, and endosperm. This flour is rich in fibre, protein, and essential nutrients like iron, magnesium, and B vitamins. It lends a robust, nutty flavour to baked goods and is commonly used in bread, pasta, and pastries. Whole wheat flour is a healthier alternative to refined white flour, supporting better digestion and providing more nutritional benefits.

"Unga wa Ngano Isiyokobolewa" hutengenezwa kwa kusaga punje nzima ya ngano, ikiwa na pumba, kiini na sehemu yake ya ndani yenye wanga. Unga huu una nyuzinyuzi, protini na virutubisho muhimu kwa wingi, kama madini chuma, magnesiamu na vitamini B. Huvipa vyakula vya kuoka ladha nzito inayofanana na ya karanga, na hutumika sana kutengeneza mkate, tambi, keki na vitafunwa vingine vya kuoka. Ni mbadala bora kiafya wa unga mweupe uliokobolewa, kwani husaidia mmeng'enyo mzuri wa chakula na una faida zaidi za lishe.

A rich spread made from ground pumpkin seeds, this butter is a treasure trove of nutrients, including healthy fats, protein, magnesium, zinc, and antioxidants, all without added sugars or preservatives. Pumpkin seed butter is not only a delight to the taste buds with its nutty, earthy flavour but also a boon to health, promoting heart health, prostate health, and immune function. Its high magnesium content supports sleep and stress reduction, making it a nutritious and versatile addition to any diet.

Siagi hii nzito imetengenezwa kwa mbegu za maboga zilizosagwa, na ni hazina ya virutubisho: mafuta yenye afya, protini, magnesiamu, zinki na antioxidants, bila sukari iliyoongezwa wala vihifadhi. Siagi ya mbegu za maboga si tamu tu mdomoni kwa ladha yake ya asili inayofanana na ya karanga, bali pia ni baraka kwa afya: husaidia afya ya moyo, afya ya tezi dume na kinga ya mwili. Kwa kuwa ina magnesiamu nyingi, husaidia kupata usingizi mzuri na kupunguza msongo wa mawazo, hivyo ni nyongeza yenye lishe inayotumika kwa namna nyingi katika mlo wa aina yoyote.

High in protein, fiber, and essential amino acids. Rich in vitamins B and E, magnesium, iron, potassium, calcium, and phosphorus. Gluten-free. Supports heart health, aids digestion, boosts energy levels, promotes healthy skin and contributes to weight management. Ideal for gluten-sensitive diets.

Ina protini, nyuzinyuzi na asidi amino muhimu kwa wingi. Imejaa vitamini B na E, magnesiamu, madini chuma, potasiamu, kalsiamu na fosforasi. Haina gluteni. Husaidia afya ya moyo na mmeng'enyo wa chakula, huongeza nguvu, huboresha afya ya ngozi na husaidia kudhibiti uzito. Inafaa kwa wale ambao gluteni haiwafai.
Bold, whole grains, naturally hearty and satisfying. A robust foundation for a nourishing start.
Punje kubwa na nzima za oats, zinazoshibisha kwa asili. Msingi imara wa kuanza siku kwa lishe bora.
**Wholesome, gently steamed and rolled for a tender, hearty bite. Naturally nourishing, endlessly versatile.**
**Oats bora, zilizopikwa kwa mvuke taratibu kisha kubanwa kuwa bapa, hivyo ni laini na zinashibisha. Zina lishe ya asili na zinafaa kwa mapishi ya kila aina.**
Baked in small batches and sweetened with date syrup or raw pine honey.
Huokwa kwa mafungu madogo na kutiwa utamu kwa sharubati ya tende au asali mbichi ya misonobari.

This delightful mix of almonds, coconut, flaxseeds, and dark chocolate chips is crafted without grains and baked with love. It is rich in healthy fats, fibre, antioxidants, and a hint of sweetness from dark chocolate. These grain-free almond cookies offer a guilt-free indulgence, perfect for satisfying sweet cravings while providing nutritional benefits like heart health support, energy boosts, and a dose of antioxidants. Ideal for a wholesome snack or a healthy dessert option.

Mchanganyiko huu mtamu wa lozi, nazi, mbegu za kitani na vipande vya chokoleti nyeusi umetengenezwa bila nafaka na kuokwa kwa upendo. Una mafuta yenye afya, nyuzinyuzi na antioxidants kwa wingi, pamoja na utamu kidogo kutoka kwenye chokoleti nyeusi. Biskuti hizi za lozi zisizo na nafaka unaweza kuzifurahia bila wasiwasi: zinatuliza hamu ya kitu kitamu huku zikikupa faida za lishe, kama kusaidia afya ya moyo na kukuongezea nguvu na antioxidants. Zinafaa kama kitafunwa bora au kitindamlo chenye afya.

A wholesome blend of sesame seeds and mixed nuts bound together with natural honey, these nut bites are completely free from added sugar and packed with healthy fats, protein, and essential minerals. They offer a nutritious, sweet treat without the sugar spike, perfect for energy boosts and satisfying cravings. They support heart health, aid in digestion, and provide sustained energy. Ideal for a healthy, on-the-go snack.

Mchanganyiko bora wa ufuta na jamii ya karanga, ulioshikamanishwa kwa asali asilia. Vipande hivi havina sukari yoyote iliyoongezwa, na vimejaa mafuta yenye afya, protini na madini muhimu. Ni kitafunwa kitamu chenye lishe kisichopandisha sukari mwilini ghafla, kinachofaa kukuongezea nguvu na kutuliza hamu ya kitu kitamu. Husaidia afya ya moyo na mmeng'enyo wa chakula, na hukupa nguvu kwa muda mrefu. Ni chaguo bora la kitafunwa chenye afya cha kubeba popote.

These bites are crafted with almonds, oats, and a mix of seeds, including flaxseeds, pumpkin seeds and sunflower, and sweetened naturally with honey. Made without eggs or butter, offering a rich blend of protein, fibre, healthy fats, and essential nutrients like calcium, magnesium, and vitamin E. These wholesome protein dips provide a satisfying crunch with every bite, combining the nutritional power of nuts, seeds, and whole grains. They're perfect for energy boosts, supporting heart health, aiding digestion, and nourishing skin. Ideal for those seeking a delicious, healthful snack without the use of eggs or butter.

Vitafunwa hivi vimeandaliwa kwa lozi, oats na mchanganyiko wa mbegu, zikiwemo mbegu za kitani, mbegu za maboga na alizeti, na vimetiwa utamu wa asili kwa asali. Havina mayai wala siagi, na vina mchanganyiko mzuri wa protini, nyuzinyuzi, mafuta yenye afya na virutubisho muhimu kama kalsiamu, magnesiamu na vitamini E. Kila kipande ni kikavu na kitamu kukitafuna, na kinaunganisha nguvu ya lishe ya karanga, mbegu na nafaka zisizokobolewa. Vinafaa kukuongezea nguvu, kusaidia afya ya moyo na mmeng'enyo wa chakula, na kurutubisha ngozi. Ni chaguo bora kwa anayetafuta kitafunwa kitamu na chenye afya kisicho na mayai wala siagi.

These bites are crafted with whole wheat, oats, dark chocolate chips and a mix of seeds, including flaxseeds, pumpkin seeds and sunflower, and sweetened naturally with honey. Made without eggs or butter, offering a rich blend of protein, fibre, healthy fats, and essential nutrients like calcium, magnesium, and vitamin E. These wholesome protein dips provide a satisfying crunch with every bite, combining the nutritional power of nuts, seeds, and whole grains. They're perfect for energy boosts, supporting heart health, aiding digestion, and nourishing skin. Ideal for those seeking a delicious, healthful snack without the use of eggs or butter.

Havina mayai wala siagi, na vina mchanganyiko mzuri wa protini, nyuzinyuzi, mafuta yenye afya na virutubisho muhimu kama kalsiamu, magnesiamu na vitamini E. Vinafaa kukuongezea nguvu, kusaidia afya ya moyo na mmeng'enyo wa chakula, na kurutubisha ngozi. Ni chaguo bora kwa anayetafuta kitafunwa kitamu na chenye afya kisicho na mayai wala siagi.

A crunchy, wholesome blend of oats mixed, peanuts, milk chocolate chips and lightly sweetened with natural sweeteners (honey). It is packed with fibre, protein, and essential nutrients like iron and magnesium without any artificial additives. Kids Cookies provides a sustained energy release, supports digestive health, and helps maintain healthy cholesterol levels. Its deliciously crunchy texture and versatility make it an ideal breakfast option or snack for children from 1 year old.

Biskuti hizi kavu na tamu zimetengenezwa kwa mchanganyiko bora wa oats, karanga na vipande vya chokoleti ya maziwa, na zimetiwa utamu kidogo kwa kitamu cha asili (asali). Zina nyuzinyuzi, protini na virutubisho muhimu kama madini chuma na magnesiamu, bila viambato bandia. Kids Cookies humpa mtoto nguvu kwa muda mrefu, husaidia mmeng'enyo mzuri wa chakula na husaidia kudumisha kiwango kizuri cha lehemu (kolesteroli). Ni kavu na tamu, na zinaweza kuliwa kwa namna nyingi, hivyo ni chaguo bora la kifungua kinywa au asusa kwa watoto wenye umri wa mwaka 1 na kuendelea.

Made with love and zero guilt! These naturally delicious oat cookies are free from added sugars or sweeteners, and they have the wholesome taste of oats, seeds, and clean ingredients. Perfect for mindful snacking anytime, anywhere.

Zimeokwa kwa upendo, na unazila bila kujutia! Biskuti hizi za oats zenye utamu wa asili hazina sukari wala vitamu vyovyote vilivyoongezwa, na zina ladha halisi ya oats, mbegu na viambato safi. Zinafaa kama kitafunwa cha kula kwa kiasi na kwa utulivu, wakati wowote, mahali popote.

Support your breastfeeding journey with our Lactating Cookies, specially crafted with oats, almonds, whole wheat, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds and flaxseeds to help promote milk production. Enriched with wholesome nuts, seeds, and natural ingredients, these cookies are a delicious and nutritious snack for new mums, providing energy and essential nutrients during this special time.

Lactating Cookies zetu ni rafiki yako katika kipindi cha kunyonyesha. Zimetengenezwa maalumu kwa oats, lozi, ngano isiyokobolewa, mbegu za maboga, mbegu za alizeti na mbegu za kitani ili kusaidia kuongeza maziwa ya mama. Zimerutubishwa kwa jamii ya karanga, mbegu na viambato vya asili, na ni kitafunwa kitamu chenye lishe kwa mama aliyejifungua hivi karibuni, kinachompa nguvu na virutubisho muhimu katika kipindi hiki maalumu.

Crafted with the warmth of ginger, these cookies are sweetened naturally without sugar. They blend whole ingredients for a spicy, comforting treat, rich in antioxidants and fibre. These ginger cookies offer a guilt-free indulgence, perfect for soothing the palate and warming the soul. They aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and provide a gentle energy lift. Ideal for a healthful snack or a comforting dessert option.

Biskuti hizi zimekolezwa kwa tangawizi, na utamu wake ni wa asili, bila sukari. Zimetengenezwa kwa viambato asilia kamili, zikiwa na ladha ya viungo inayoburudisha pamoja na viondoa sumu mwilini na nyuzinyuzi kwa wingi. Ni starehe isiyo na majuto, nzuri kwa kutuliza kinywa na kuchangamsha moyo. Husaidia mmeng'enyo wa chakula, hupunguza uvimbe mwilini na hukuongezea nguvu taratibu. Ni chaguo zuri kwa kitafunwa chenye afya au kitindamlo kitamu.

A delectable combination of sugar-free dark chocolate chips mixed into whole wheat dough, these cookies are crafted without sugar and offer a rich, satisfying treat packed with fibre and antioxidants. Benefits: Enjoy the classic delight of chocolate chip cookies without the sugar rush. Perfect for maintaining energy levels, supporting heart health, and indulging in a guilt-free treat. Ideal for a nutritious snack or a healthier dessert option

Vipande vya chokoleti nyeusi isiyo na sukari vimechanganywa kwenye unga wa ngano isiyokobolewa, na biskuti hizi zimeokwa bila sukari kabisa. Ni tamu, zinashibisha, na zina nyuzinyuzi na viondoa sumu mwilini kwa wingi. Faida: Furahia ladha ya biskuti za chokoleti uzipendazo bila sukari mwilini kupanda ghafla. Husaidia kudumisha nguvu mwilini, huimarisha afya ya moyo, na ni starehe isiyo na majuto. Ni chaguo zuri kwa kitafunwa chenye lishe au kitindamlo bora zaidi kiafya.

Purely made from finely ground almonds, this butter is a creamy, nutrient-rich spread. It's packed with healthy fats, protein, vitamins E and B, magnesium, and fibre, without any added sugars or preservatives. Almond butter provides a heart-healthy boost, aids in muscle recovery and skin health, and supports balanced blood sugar levels. Its smooth, rich texture and nutty flavour make it a versatile and satisfying addition to any meal or snack, offering a delicious way to fuel your body.

Siagi hii imetengenezwa kwa lozi tupu zilizosagwa laini. Ni laini, rahisi kupaka, na ina virutubisho vingi. Ina mafuta yenye afya, protini, vitamini E na B, magnesiamu na nyuzinyuzi, bila sukari wala vihifadhi vilivyoongezwa. Siagi ya lozi huimarisha afya ya moyo, husaidia misuli kupona baada ya mazoezi, hutunza afya ya ngozi na husaidia sukari mwilini kubaki imetulia. Ulaini wake na ladha yake nzito ya lozi vinaifanya ifae kwenye mlo wowote au kitafunwa chochote, njia tamu ya kuupa mwili wako nguvu.

A luxurious blend of almonds, cashews, walnuts and pecans, finely ground into a smooth, rich butter. This nutrient-dense spread offers a symphony of healthy fats, proteins, vitamins, and minerals, with no added sugars or unnecessary additives. Mixed nuts butter is a powerhouse of nutrition, supporting heart health, brain function, and providing sustained energy. Its complex flavour profile enhances any meal or snack, making it a versatile and delicious choice for a health-conscious diet.

Mchanganyiko murua wa lozi, korosho, walnuts na pecans, uliosagwa laini kuwa siagi nzito na laini. Siagi hii yenye virutubisho tele inakuletea mafuta yenye afya, protini, vitamini na madini kwa pamoja, bila sukari wala viongezeo visivyo vya lazima. Ni hazina ya lishe: huimarisha afya ya moyo, husaidia ubongo kufanya kazi vizuri na hukupa nguvu za kudumu. Ladha yake ya kipekee huongeza utamu kwenye mlo wowote au kitafunwa, hivyo ni chaguo tamu kwa yeyote anayejali afya yake.

Macros Baby Butter is a smooth, natural nut-and-seed blend made for adding rich flavour and extra nourishment to baby meals like porridge and soft foods. It combines ingredients such as almond, cashew, peanut, and sesame for a creamy, wholesome boost.

Macros Baby Butter ni mchanganyiko laini na wa asili wa jamii ya karanga na mbegu, uliotengenezwa kuongeza ladha nzuri na lishe ya ziada kwenye chakula cha mtoto kama uji na vyakula laini. Una viambato kama lozi, korosho, karanga na ufuta, vinavyoongeza ulaini na lishe bora kwenye chakula chake.
